provenance.dataset: CMS 2016 Open Data, SingleMuon Run2016G+H, NanoAODv9 (records 30530, 30563)
provenance.naming: map_mean = np.mean over the (pT, |eta|) map (what RESULTS_v2.md quotes); sr_event_mean = weighted mean over the selected signal-region events of the new MC pass (zmumu_sr_stack.json mean_factors)

pileup.data_profile_unit: recorded luminosity [pb^-1] per bin (sums to lumi_pb)
pileup.mc_profile_note: genWeight-weighted Pileup_nTrueInt of all generated DY_NLO events (GenSums)
pileup.mean_note: data_mean and mc_mean use bin centres (i + 0.5, as pileup.py:data_profile); docs/11-mc-weights.md:28 quotes the MC mean with the lower-edge convention (21.9 = mc_mean_lower_edge)
pileup.data_profile_integral_note: the smeared nominal/up/down profiles lose ~2e-6 of the luminosity in the Gaussian tails outside the 100 bins; csv_raw integrates to lumi_pb exactly
pileup.weights_note: w(nTrueInt) = data/MC profile ratio, unit mean over the MC profile, clipped at 10 (zmumu/pileup.py:_weights)

prefiring.branch: L1PreFiringWeight_Nom = Muon_Nom x ECAL_Nom (Up/Dn for the systematic)

scale_factors.definition: tight ID given loose probe; isolation (pfRelIso04 < 0.15) given tight ID; anti-isolation (0.20 < iso < 1.0) given tight ID; T&P fits (Z lineshape + background) in data and DY MC, SF = eff_data / eff_mc

trigger.path: HLT_IsoMu24 || HLT_IsoTkMu24, matched to a TrigObj (id 13, filterBits & (2|8), pT > 24) within dR < 0.1

momentum.definition: kappa_j = 1 + (mu_data - mu_MC)/m_Z and s_j = sqrt(2(sigma_data^2 - sigma_MC^2))/m_Z from Breit-Wigner (x) Gaussian fits of the Z peak with both muons in the same |eta| bin (zmumu/momentum.py); MC pT -> pT kappa (1 + s N(0,1))

checks.name: nominal (smeared) data profile integral == lumi_pb within 1e-5 (tails outside 100 bins)
MC profile mean 21.9 (lower-edge convention of docs/11)
sf_event == id_pair x iso_pair x trigger (within 0.2%)
